tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new hosting project on the caller's account (counts against the caller's project quota). To edit a shared site, pass that project's project_id to upload/deploy tools instead.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects the caller owns or is a member of

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get project details

tools.name: update_project_settings
tools.description: Update project name, description, check thresholds, or analyticsEnabled (cookieless edge traffic; off by default).

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Get a presigned PUT URL for a site file. content_type is optional (inferred from extension).

tools.name: get_upload_urls_batch
tools.description: Presign many site files at once (max 100). Prefer this for multi-file sites.

tools.name: confirm_upload
tools.description: Confirm a completed upload and record metadata. content_type optional.

tools.name: confirm_uploads_batch
tools.description: Confirm many uploads. 200 body is { files, errors }. errors is always an array (empty on full success); retry only failed paths.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files for a project

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Get file metadata

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from staging

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Publish the site. Verified accounts run quality checks; unverified accounts skip checks (checkRuns: 0) and still go live. POST returns quickly — poll get_deployment_status until live or failed. Do not retry POST while status is promoting or checking.

tools.name: get_deployment_status
tools.description: Get latest or specific deployment status

tools.name: get_preview_url
tools.description: Get the public preview/live URL for a project

tools.name: run_checks
tools.description: Run quality checks (triggers a deploy check cycle)

tools.name: get_checks_results
tools.description: Get quality check results for the latest deployment

tools.name: configure_custom_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom domain. For site domains, enables apex+www. Default primary=www with redirect (Vercel-style). Pass primary=apex or redirect=false to change.

tools.name: get_domain_status
tools.description: Get custom domain status

tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a Novence form on a project (optional — sites may use Formspree/Web3forms instead). Returns submit URLs for edge + public API.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List Novence forms for a project

tools.name: update_form
tools.description: Update form schema, notify email, or status (active|disabled)

tools.name: list_form_submissions
tools.description: List submissions for a Novence form (paginated)

tools.name: delete_form_submission
tools.description: Delete one form submission (PII)

tools.name: get_quotas_and_usage
tools.description: Get plan quotas and current usage

tools.name: get_project_usage
tools.description: Per-project usage (storage, deploys, check minutes, bandwidth, forms). Bandwidth is live from edge-served bytes.

tools.name: get_project_analytics
tools.description: Cookieless edge analytics for a hosted site: pageviews, 404s, top pages, referrers, and countries. Off by default. Enable with update_project_settings analytics_enabled=true. Default last 7 days (max 90). If disabled, returns enabled=false and empty totals.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Full account snapshot: profile, subscription, quotas, usage, projects

tools.name: create_account_session
tools.description: Mint a short-lived mgmt_ token for a local HTML console (account:read, billing:portal, project:members). Never put nv_ keys in HTML.

tools.name: get_account_console_kit
tools.description: JSON kit to write a local novence-console.html: snapshot, HTML template, session mint instructions. Serve on localhost.

tools.name: invite_project_member
tools.description: Invite a collaborator by email. Requires Pro/Scale on the project owner. Only the owner can invite as admin. Creates a new project on the caller's account if you use create_project instead — pass project_id here. Do not share the owner's nv_ key.

tools.name: list_project_members
tools.description: List members and pending invites for a project

tools.name: update_project_member
tools.description: Change a collaborator's role. Only the owner can grant or demote admin.

tools.name: remove_project_member
tools.description: Remove a collaborator and revoke their project API keys. Owner-only for admins.

tools.name: revoke_project_invite
tools.description: Revoke a pending invite

tools.name: leave_project
tools.description: Leave a project you were invited to. Owners cannot leave.

tools.name: accept_project_invite
tools.description: Accept an invite token (from email or invite_project_member in local/dev). Unverified invitees must pass otp. Returns a project-scoped nv_ key once — never email it. Collaborating uses this project_id; create_project still bills the caller.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "update_project_settings" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Update project name, description, check thresholds, or analyticsEnabled (cookieless edge traffic; off by default).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "get_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: Cookieless edge analytics for a hosted site: pageviews, 404s, top pages, referrers, and countries. Off by default. Enable with update_project_settings analytics…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, get_preview_url, create_account_session, get_account_console_kit · Private data: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, confirm_uploads_batch, list_files, get_file, delete_file, create_account_session, remove_project_member, accept_project_invite · Public sink: create_project, get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, deploy, create_form, update_form, invite_project_member, accept_project_invite · Destructive: delete_file, deploy, run_checks, delete_form_submission, remove_project_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, get_preview_url, create_account_session, get_account_console_kit · Private data: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, confirm_uploads_batch, list_files, get_file, delete_file, create_account_session, remove_project_member, accept_project_invite · Public sink: create_project, get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, deploy, create_form, update_form, invite_project_member, accept_project_invite · Destructive: delete_file, deploy, run_checks, delete_form_submission, remove_project_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
